name: Dual camera capture
summary: A capture mode that takes a photo with the back camera and the front camera in one moment.
how: Show the back photo full frame and the front photo in a small inset.
Record a time stamp and a late mark.

origin.note: BeReal releases an app that asks users to post a back and a front camera photo at a random time.

adoptions.via: BeReal grows fast, and its two-camera snapshot becomes a common look in social feeds.
